tool_calls.literal:
/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.stack_frames[0], (.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$2>0)p[$1]+=$2; else n[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in p) printf "%s'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\n\",k,p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k]; for(k in n) if("'!(k in p)) printf "%s'"\\t0\\t%d\\t%d\\n\",k,n[k],-n[k]}' | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k4,4nr | head -30
jq -r '[.stack_frames[2], (.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$2>0)p[$1]+=$2; else n[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in p) printf "%s'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\n\",k,p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k]}' | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k4,4nr | head -25
jq -s '{lines:length,bad_ops:map(select(.value>0)|.value)|add,good_ops:(map(select(.value<0)|-.value)|add),bad_sessions:([.[]|select(.value>0)|.labels.source_session[0]]|unique|length),good_sessions:([.[]|select(.value<0)|.labels.source_session[0]]|unique|length)}' samples.jsonl"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -s 'def side("'$sgn): [ .[] | select((.value*$sgn)>0) ]; (side(1)) as $b | (side(-1)) as $g | {bad:{all:($b|map(.value)|add),repeated:($b|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|.value)|add),sessions:($b|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length)},good:{all:($g|map(-.value)|add),repeated:($g|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|-.value)|add),sessions:($g|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length)}}'"' samples.jsonl
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.stack_frames[2],(.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$2>0)b[$1]+=$2;else g[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in b)printf "%s'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\n\",k,b[k],g[k],b[k]-g[k]}' | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k4,4nr | head -10"
